in_hindi.name: किमाया
in_hindi.long_meaning: काम पूरा करने वाला (one who fulfills desire)

in_marathi.name: Kimaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Nature
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kimaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Nature and Creativity. In Hinduism, Kimaya represents the divine feminine and the cyclical nature of life.

in_bengali.name: Kimaya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Nature
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kimaya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of Nature and Creativity. In Hinduism, Kimaya represents the divine feminine and the cyclical nature of life.
